items.title: Enterprise Document Processing

items.source_text:
Google’s Gemini 3.6 Flash is now available on Databricks!

In Databricks internal evaluations, it classified documents more accurately than Gemini 3.5 Flash and performed especially well on long-form patents and text-heavy documents. For document parsing, medium effort delivered similar quality to high effort while using about 32% fewer total tokens. It also landed on the cost-quality frontier in our OfficeQA Pro agent harness benchmark.

Congrats to the @Google Gemini team on this release. We can’t wait to see what you build with it! https://t.co/WwEcsAiJg4

items.title: Golden Gate Bridge HTML Failure
items.takeaway: Use a strict file-delivery task to test instruction following before trusting generated 3D web experiences.
items.body_notes: The tester needed three prompts, saw the model attempt an in-app simulation and web-image responses instead of the requested HTML file, and judged the final 3D bridge output materially weaker than Gemini 3.1 Pro.
items.decision_reason: 生成金门大桥 3D HTML 体验并记录多轮修正与功能失败
items.source_text:
🚨Gemini 3.6 Flash is trash

I tested it on a 3D Golden Gate Bridge, and the results were awful.

• I had to re-prompt it three times because it repeatedly ignored the instructions.

• First attempt, instead of creating the requested .html file, it first tried to build the experience inside the Gemini app using simulations. 

• Then second attempt it started placing images from the web into the chat rather than actually producing the file.

• Even after getting it to complete the task, the final output was dramatically worse than Gemini 3.1 Pro, which is 5 months old and now not even a top 10 model on leaderboards.

This feels like a regression from Gemini 3.5 Flash and honestly, it is one of the weakest models I have tested in the past few months.

Has anyone else tested Gemini 3.6 Flash yet, and are you seeing the same thing?

items.decision_reason: 用最新旗舰模型问题测试模型知识截止时间并保留错误回答
items.source_text:
😠Gemini 3.6 Flash claiming a March 2026 knowledge cutoff just answered with GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Gemini 1.5 Pro, Grok-2, and Qwen2.5 as the latest flagship models of March 2026. It even admitted its knowledge was only current to early 2025.

Google, please quietly quit the AI race and stop pouring all this effort into more Flash models.

Deep in our hearts, we already know you won the AI race. You just can’t prove it with an actual flagship model. Please stop putting us through this misery.
